summary_en: First post-IPO dividend of 76 yen/share approved for FY4/26 (ended April 2026), reflecting 18.0% payout ratio on net income of ¥1,310M. Policy commits to continued stable dividend growth with target payout ratio to be raised progressively. FY5/27 dividend also set at 76 yen/share (20.6% payout ratio forecast).
title_en: Notice of Dividend Payment (First Post-Listing Dividend) and Dividend Policy
translation_en_brief:
On 15 June 2026, TO Books announced its first dividend payment since listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market on 13 February 2026. The company's board approved a dividend of 76 yen per share for the fiscal year ended 30 April 2026, based on net income of ¥1,310 million and reflecting a payout ratio of 18.0%. This represents the inaugural post-IPO dividend and exceeds the company's previously published earnings forecast (issued 16 March 2026); actual FY4/26 operating profit was ¥1,984 million (72.7% YoY growth) against a forecast range of ¥1,700–1,900 million.

The company has adopted a performance-linked payout ratio framework with a stated principle of "continuous and stable shareholder returns". Management intends to raise the payout ratio progressively over time while prioritizing growth investment in intellectual property creation and multimedia development. The dividend has an ex-date of 30 April 2026 and becomes effective 30 July 2026.

For FY5/27 (ending April 2027), the company has also announced a dividend of 76 yen per share, maintaining the same payment level but reflecting a forecast payout ratio of 20.6%. Management signalled that the long-term target payout ratio will exceed 25%.
